_schema.description: Engineering prior database for HETP / overall efficiency of cryogenic hydrogen-isotope distillation columns. Not a physical constant table: every entry carries source, validity range and uncertainty. Primary source for most packing entries: L. Shere et al., Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 55 (2024) 319-338, Table 8 (DOI 10.1016/j.ijhydene.2023.10.282), source-reported as verified against the open-access PDF on 2026-10-08 (not re-verified in this repository).

entry_fields.name: canonical packing/tray name
entry_fields.hetp_m: representative height equivalent to a theoretical plate [m]
entry_fields.range_m: [min, max] range reported by the source, when a range is given
entry_fields.validity: system, pressure and load range the value is valid for
entry_fields.notes: free text, including conflicts between sources

_integration_note.statement: This database was imported into h2iso as an experimental integration. Content, provenance labels and DOIs have NOT been independently re-verified in this repository; entries sourced from third-party compilations are engineering priors, not calibrated or in-house measured values. Do not cite this file as validated physical data. Entries whose DOI could not be confirmed are stored with doi=null and the reason recorded in notes.

packings.name: Generic cryo H/D/T design value
packings.source: ITER ISS design baseline (adopted from TPL/JAERI H-D-T experiments); TSTA design value was also 50 mm; Barrow et al. 2025 used 66.7 mm
packings.validity: 20-26 K, near-ambient pressure, small-diameter packed columns
packings.notes: Conservative engineering default. Literature spans 2-8 cm depending on packing; see individual entries. Not a physical constant. doi was a delivery-side placeholder ('...00000-placeholder-see-notes'), not a resolvable identifier: set to null and left unverified in this repository.

packings.name: Spiral prismatic 2 x 2 mm (nitric-acid pickled)
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (PNPI, refs [12,189]); lowest HETP reported in the compilation
packings.validity: H2-HD, 2.2 cm ID, 1.55 m packing, 120-900 kPa, ~20 K, 20 W @ 20 K
packings.notes: Nitric-acid pickling roughens the surface; best reported value in the field.

packings.name: Heli-Pak 2 x 2.5 mm
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (Osaka Univ.; H2-HD-D2, 3.2 cm ID, 1.10 m, 38 stages)
packings.notes: Shere Table 8 footnote: this HETP value was provided by the packing manufacturer.

packings.name: Helipak B (optimised)
packings.source: ITER Task T332a (1995) Low-Inventory Cryogenic Distillation Tests, report INIS 27067242, verified from the report text 2026-10-09: 'a 30-mm column could achieve a 2.0 cm HETP with about 17% hold-up at a vapour velocity of around 11 cm/s'
packings.validity: 17-50 mm ID, ~11 cm/s vapor velocity, 17% liquid loading
packings.notes: Recommended by the ITER low-inventory programme; ~24% less inventory per plate than Helipak C (TSTA 30 mm). 1.9 cm believed near the theoretical limit. Now primary-verified from the INIS report (2026-10-09).

packings.name: Helipak C
packings.source: ITER Task T332a (1996) Low-Inventory Cryogenic Distillation Tests, report INIS 28058166 (+ ITER ISS design basis), verified 2026-10-09: Helipak C 'HETP's in the vicinity of 5.5 cm'; 22 mm column measured 4.7 cm close to flooding
packings.validity: H-D-T / D2-DT, ~20 K, ITER ISS reference packing (before low-inventory programme)
packings.notes: The packing behind the 'ITER HETP = 5 cm' design number. Low-inventory programme replaced it with Helipak B (2.0 cm) for the high-tritium bottom section.

packings.name: Dixon ring 3 x 3 mm
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (JAERI/LANL/JET experiments, H-D-T and H2-D2, 1-2 cm ID)
packings.notes: Shere: 'Dixon ring packing provided the best combined performance in terms of low HETP and low pressure drop'. Individual studies report 3, 4, 5, 6 cm.

packings.name: Dixon ring 1.5 x 1.5 mm
packings.notes: Mixtures with 3 x 3 mm are common; report as a range rather than a single value.

packings.name: Heli-Pak 4.4 x 2.3 mm
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (LANL, H-D-T, 2.84/2.50 cm ID, 4.12/3.20 m packing, 183 stages)
packings.notes: Used in the widely cited 80-theoretical-stage holdup study (Iwai et al.).

packings.name: ICIT B7 structured packing
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (ICIT Rm. Valcea, D2-nH2-oH2, 4.2 cm ID, 1.2 m, 22 stages, refs [192,193])
packings.notes: CONFLICT: Croitoru et al. 2004 (Nucl. Technol. Radiat. Prot. 19(2) 52-58, DOI 10.2298/NTRP0402052C) report HTU ~0.2 m for hydrogen / ~0.1 m for water on B7. Both numbers are recorded; the conflict has not been resolved in this repository - resolve against the original papers before use.

packings.name: ICIT B5 structured packing
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (ICIT Rm. Valcea, D2-nH2-oH2, 4.2 cm ID, 1.2 m, 22 stages)

packings.name: Dixon ring & spiral ring (JET AGHS)
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (JET Culham, H-D-T, 1.6/1.6/1.7/1.3 cm ID, 260 stages, ref [182])
packings.notes: Two values reported: 6 cm and 7.5 cm depending on column.

packings.name: TSTA commercial random packing
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (TSTA, H-D-T, 310 stages, ref [11]); TSTA design basis 50 +/- 5 mm
packings.notes: The value behind the generic 5 cm design number.

packings.name: Ontario Hydro low-inventory packing
packings.source: Shere et al. 2024 Table 8 (Ontario Hydro Nuclear, D2-DT, 3.0 cm ID, 1.50 m, 73 stages, 24 K, 12 kPa, ref [177])

packings.name: Sulzer EX structured packing
packings.source: JET WDS cryogenic distillation column design (Parracho et al., CCFE poster, IAEA conference)
packings.validity: 60 mm ID upper section, 20-25 K, ~105 kPa, ~130 Pa/m pressure drop
packings.notes: Design assumption for a water-detritiation CD column - no direct hydrogen-isotope measurement found in the literature compilation (Shere et al. do not list Sulzer data).

trays.name: ICIS bubble-cap tray
trays.source: ICIS Rm. Valcea 1995, 'Determination of trays and ordered filling efficiency in the process of H2-HD distillation', in 25 Years of Activity in Cryogenics and Isotope Separation in Romania, INIS RN 28023555
trays.notes: Murphree efficiency 20-40%. This is the only public tray-efficiency measurement for H2-HD distillation found; weak evidence (conference proceedings).

trays.name: ICIS sieve tray
trays.source: ICIS Rm. Valcea 1995, same as above
